decisions.reason: Far from the firm's core chemical business and only mentioned on the website signals performance below aspirations, triggering problemistic search and likely divestment.

Modular waste-to-energy extensions align with the firm's chemical engineering capabilities and, despite only a website mention, organizational slack allows keeping while management assesses results against aspirations.
Having its own website page indicates above-aspiration performance and strategic commitment, so the firm retains it.
Plastic waste to fuel fits sustainability trends and the firm's core competencies, but its uncertain results leave moderate drop risk while slack permits continued evaluation.
